rationale: Crosses the render-assets-and-backends family through the broad core/view/** selector (overlay_dismissal, pointer_dispatch, the widget-bridge wheel payload and the web-compat element-event bubble). The Pulp-owned change contains passive pointer input at open overlays: a wheel, magnify or rotate outside every shown overlay is dropped while any interactive overlay (menu, dropdown, submenu) is open, behind the new OverlayDismissalPolicy::passive_input_outside_overlay_blocked knob (default on; off restores the modal-only rule), and a wheel that resolves inside an overlay stops at that overlay's root natively and in the DOM bubble (PassivePointerRoute::overlay, __pulpWheelBoundary in the wheel payload) instead of chaining to ancestor handlers outside it. Paint, layout, asset, renderer, canvas, Skia, Dawn and authority behavior are unchanged. Regressions are confined to test/test_overlay_routing.cpp and test/test_widget_bridge_wave2_cheap.cpp. No accepted expansion boundary moves and no Vellum implementation is changed. Registered watch-only so the family's coverage stays explicit about this input-routing change.
